name: Ore no Yancha na Otouto ga Shiranai Oji-san ni Kawareteiru
original_name: 俺のヤンチャな弟が知らないオジサンに飼われている
source:
"Oh, did you find out I'm a sugar daddy?
See, I'm a hottie, you know?
I'm cuter than the girls around here, so I can make more money.
Well, it doesn't really matter to you, bro, right?"

My little brother is being kept by a strange old man.
He receives money from his "daddy" and has relationships with multiple older men.
He's a troublemaker, a bitch, and loves sex.

"Hey, bro. You were secretly watching me having sex with that old man, weren't you...? 
Was i cute back then?
Do you want to do it with me, bro?"

Will I tell him to live an honest life?
Or will I join him in his downfall...

translation:
“哦，你发现我是糖爹了吗？
你看，我是个辣妹，你知道吗？
我比周围的女孩更可爱，所以我可以赚更多的钱。
好吧，兄弟，这对你来说并不重要，对吧？”

我的弟弟被一个奇怪的老人照顾着。
他从他的“爸爸”那里得到钱，并与多个年长的男人有关系。
他是个麻烦制造者，一个婊子，而且热爱性。

“喂，兄弟，你偷偷看着我和那个老男人做爱，是不是……？
那时的我可爱吗？
兄弟你愿意和我一起做吗？”

我会告诉他要诚实地生活吗？
或者我会和他一起走向灭亡……
